title: Few people know: the sticky note came from a failed glue
summary: A weak adhesive invented in 1968 later became the Post-it Note after years of searching for a use.
lesson: Failed experiments can still become products when someone finds the right problem.
description:
Few people know: the sticky note came from a failed glue.

In 1968, Spencer Silver at 3M created a weak, reusable adhesive while trying to invent a strong one. Years later Art Fry needed a bookmark that would stay put in a choir hymnal. Their collaboration led to Post-it Notes, launched widely in 1980.
